failure.title: Today route tests spread an unknown query-data fixture
failure.note: The retained Today-state transitions correspond to two TS2698 diagnostics because the shared controllable query slot was typed unknown and then spread directly.
failure.diagnosis: A deliberately generic route mock stored query data as unknown. Two Today-state transitions derived new objects directly from that slot, which was runtime-valid but could not satisfy strict compile-time object-spread safety.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
